messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v2.34.0 -> prod (canary 10%). Logs: https://ci/release/1789 :rocket:

maya: thumbs up — kicking off post-deploy smoke suite (prefill + synth probes). will report back in ~2m.

liam: @maya saw a p95 bump on eu-west synthetic probe right after the canary flip, p95 ~1.1s (baseline ~180ms) :thinking_face:

oncall-sre: can you paste the quick probe output? also which probe (embed vs gen)?

maya: probe name `synth-eu-west-gen-quick`
maya: raw probe snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate 200 OK
latency_ms: 1120
model_variant: redwood-1.5-quant
sequence_len: 64
```

liam: same probe in us-west: p95 190ms. so region-only.

devx: flagged in telemetry: KV cache miss bursts coincident with canary traffic; maybe warmup issue.

maya: running `kubectl exec -n prod svc/probe-check -- curl -sS http://localhost:8080/_internal/kv/cache_stats`
maya: result: `prefix_cache_hits: 2, misses: 98, warmup_in_progress: true`

oncall-sre: hmm. warmup not completing for the new variant in eu-west. is autoscaler sharding new pods across different racks? could be colder local disk/IO.

liam: suggestion: throttle canary traffic in eu-west back to 0 while we investigate. we still have global 10% but route away from eu-west.

deploy-bot: Routing policy update: canary traffic 10% -> eu-west 0% (applied). :white_check_mark:

maya: re-running synth now after routing change. initial results: p95 dropping to 240ms, still a bit high vs baseline but much better.

devx: action items: 1) keep eu-west canary traffic pinned to previous variant; 2) collect full KV warmup trace from first 5 pods; 3) run a targeted warmup job to prefill prefixes.

liam: agree. rollback whole release seems heavy — variant pin + warmup should be lower blast radius.

oncall-sre: if warmup job fails to reduce p95 to <300ms in 10m we escalate to rollback.

maya: started warmup job: `jobs/warmup --region eu-west --variant redwood-1.5-quant --prefixes-file s3://releases/v2.34/prefixes.txt`

maya: warmup logs show steady prefix fill, errors 0 so far.

liam: synth run 3 (post-warmup): p95 210ms. Adding +:eyes: reaction.

deploy-bot: Note: release notes updated with emergency pin steps and canary traffic adjustments: https://ci/release/1789/notes

devx: I'll add a short blurb for the changelog and ops runbook so support can triage if recurs.

oncall-sre: TL;DR: Hold the release in eu-west (pin to previous variant), continue global canary, warmup succeeded -> monitoring for 30m, rollback if p95 > 300ms or error rate increases >0.1%.

maya: ack. monitoring dashboard pinned in case list: https://grafana/d/xyz/smoke?var=release=v2.34.0

liam: thanks all. marking this thread as incident-adjacent but resolved for now. will follow up in a postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
